queries.description: Volume and errors: every observation (AGENT, GENERATION, TOOL, SPAN...) by step and level.

metrics.name: langfuse_observations
metrics.help: Observations started in the window.

queries.description: Latency per step. No level dimension, so each percentile covers every observation of that step.

metrics.name: langfuse_observation_latency_avg_ms
metrics.help: Average observation latency in ms.

metrics.name: langfuse_observation_latency_p50_ms
metrics.help: Median observation latency in ms.

metrics.name: langfuse_observation_latency_p95_ms
metrics.help: p95 observation latency in ms.

metrics.name: langfuse_observation_latency_p99_ms
metrics.help: p99 observation latency in ms.

queries.description: LLM calls only, so model is always set. Cost is 0 for models Langfuse has no price for; time to first token appears only for streaming calls.

metrics.name: langfuse_input_tokens
metrics.help: Input tokens used in the window.

metrics.name: langfuse_output_tokens
metrics.help: Output tokens used in the window.

metrics.name: langfuse_total_tokens
metrics.help: Total tokens used in the window.

metrics.name: langfuse_input_cost_usd
metrics.help: Input cost in USD in the window.

metrics.name: langfuse_output_cost_usd
metrics.help: Output cost in USD in the window.

metrics.name: langfuse_total_cost_usd
metrics.help: Total cost in USD in the window.

metrics.name: langfuse_generation_latency_sum_ms
metrics.help: Summed LLM call time in ms; output_tokens / (this / 1000) is output tokens/sec.

metrics.name: langfuse_tokens_per_second_avg
metrics.help: Average (input + output) tokens per second of LLM call time.

metrics.name: langfuse_output_tokens_per_second_avg
metrics.help: Average output tokens per second after the first token (streaming only).

metrics.name: langfuse_time_to_first_token_p50_ms
metrics.help: Median time to first token in ms (streaming only).

metrics.name: langfuse_time_to_first_token_p95_ms
metrics.help: p95 time to first token in ms (streaming only).

queries.description: Root observations stand in for traces, which v2 has no view for.

metrics.name: langfuse_traces
metrics.help: Traces (root observations) started in the window.

metrics.name: langfuse_trace_latency_p50_ms
metrics.help: Median end-to-end trace latency in ms.

metrics.name: langfuse_trace_latency_p95_ms
metrics.help: p95 end-to-end trace latency in ms.

queries.description: The scores-numeric view also holds boolean scores; the filter leaves those to scores_boolean.

metrics.name: langfuse_numeric_scores
metrics.help: Numeric scores recorded in the window.

metrics.name: langfuse_numeric_score_avg
metrics.help: Average numeric score value.

metrics.name: langfuse_boolean_scores
metrics.help: Boolean scores recorded in the window.

metrics.name: langfuse_boolean_score_true_ratio
metrics.help: Share of boolean scores that are true (0-1).

metrics.name: langfuse_categorical_scores
metrics.help: Categorical scores recorded in the window, by value.
